newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH HOUSE REJECTS KRAUS AS KREDITNI PROBE CHAIR.
newsitem.headline: CZECH HOUSE REJECTS KRAUS AS KREDITNI PROBE CHAIR.

text.p: The lower house of Czech parliament in two separate votes on Wednesday rejected two opposition candidates for chairman of the special commission investigating the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s. in August.
Social Democrat member of parliament Michal Kraus failed to get the majority of votes present twice, getting only 57 of the 185 members voting in the second round.

A candidate put forward by the extreme-right wing Republican Party also was rejected twice by wide margins. Party leaders have begun discussions to find new candidates to put forward to head the commission.

Last week parliament agreed to create the commission after Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus relented in his objection to the probe of the Plzen-based bank, which collapsed with losses estimated at about 12 billion crowns.
